source: labs workflow_run_indicators(run_id 11139, program_id 10152, limit 500) — kaduna-graduation/20261015-1411 programme report 10512, read 2026-10-16 (ace#3053); measures = indicators_doc.measures meta of semantic registry 10510 v5 (semantic_registry_get, same day), value measures only (bands/target absent because the PDD sets none). Every cell is band 'unbanded'.

meta.label: Home-visit coverage
meta.plain: Of the completed months each woman has been in the programme, the share in which her mentor met her at a routine home visit.
meta.scope_note: PDD § Success Metrics — routine home-visit coverage (% of participant-months with a completed routine visit); PDD § B5.12 one routine visit a month. Target is a placeholder in the PDD, so none is set.

meta.label: Transfer not arrived
meta.plain: Of the home visits sampled for the transfer check, the share where she said this month's consumption transfer had not arrived; each one is flagged for the programme team.
meta.scope_note: PDD § B5.12 — on a sample of visits, whether this month's consumption transfer arrived; one that did not is flagged for the program team (PDD § Evidence Model, Layer B). No target in the PDD.

meta.label: Short visits
meta.plain: Of routine home visits, the share Connect flagged as implausibly short; a flagged visit waits for review before it is approved.
meta.scope_note: PDD § Evidence Model, Layer A — Connect form-duration flag on (the implausibly short rule; threshold a programme-manager setting). No target in the PDD.

meta.label: Exits
meta.plain: Of the women with a routine home visit, the share whose mentor recorded at a routine visit that she has left the programme.

meta.label: Payable visits
meta.plain: Of routine home visits, the share that count for payment: the first visit in the month at which she was met and is still enrolled.
meta.scope_note: PDD § Evidence Model, Layer A and PDD § Payment units — routine home visit paid only for the first routine visit in the month, she has not left. No target in the PDD.

meta.label: Transfer not in her control
meta.plain: Of the home visits sampled for the transfer check, the share where she said someone else controls the money; loss of control opens an escalation.
